name: com.bigicegames.big.unity.networking.physics
description: Physics-play toolkit of the BIG ecosystem: first-person physical player with stretchy sticky hands, hanging ropes / lamps, breakable hinges (doors), grabbable ragdolls — and their co-op networking on BIG.Unity.Networking (everyone simulates themselves and what they hold; grab = take over; remote forces for shared objects). The core works offline. Networking part REQUIRES BIG.Unity, BIG.Unity.Networking and FishNet; the player input needs the Input System.
